dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: The trailing edge is exceptionally linear with minimal falcation, forming a straight-line spline from the mid-base to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute, sharply pointed apex with a pixel radius of approximately 2-3 pixels.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: High angular steepness, measured at approximately 75-80 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Extremely high ratio, with the vertical pixel height being approximately 3.5 times the width of the visible base.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, smooth convex arc forming the dorsal-anterior cranial boundary with a consistent curvature radius.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, robust rostrum with a thick base-to-length ratio of approximately 1:1, extending from the melon's lower boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Measurable obtuse angle of approximately 155 degrees at the transition point where the melon slope meets the dorsal rostrum line.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly luminous cyan surface coloration with high-contrast specular highlights on the dorsal ridge and melon; mandible is slightly agape at the anterior-most point.
